religion.note: Yemen's 2004 census published no religion table: the US Census Bureau's workbook of the census reproduces its tables on dwellings and households, nationality (Table 25), orphanhood (Table 31), disability (Table 35) and computer and internet use (Tables 23-24), and its data dictionary cites no other census table; UNdata's census tables reported to the UN Statistics Division hold none for Yemen either.

ethnicity.note: The 2004 census's nationality table (Table 25, resident population by nationality, gender and governorate) is published by governorate only, as the US Census Bureau's workbook reproduces it, so no district's split of Yemeni and foreign nationals is known.
